bind_address.description: IP address the APT-Cacher service binds to. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces.

port.description: TCP port the service listens on.

cache_dir.description: Directory where cached package files are stored.

allow_remote_requests.description: If true, allow clients from any IP (subject to allowed_clients/hosts). If false, only local (127.0.0.1) requests are accepted.

allowed_clients.description: List of allowed client IPs/CIDR subnets. Use 'all' to allow anyone (not recommended).

allowed_hosts.description: List of allowed hostnames (DNS patterns). Used in combination with allowed_clients.

max_threads.description: Maximum number of worker threads for handling concurrent requests.

min_free_space_mb.description: Minimum free disk space (MB) in the cache directory before the service refuses new downloads.

devuan_support.description: Enable support for Devuan repositories (disables systemd-specific logic).

ignore_expire.description: If true, bypass expiration of stale cache entries (keep all files indefinitely).

max_age_days.description: Maximum age (in days) for cached files before they’re considered expired (unless ignore_expire is set).

remap_debian.description: Base URL for remapping the Debian repository. Set to '' to disable remapping.

remap_ubuntu.description: Base URL for remapping the Ubuntu repository.

remap_backports.description: Base URL for Debian backports. Set to '' to disable.

remap_security.description: Base URL for Debian security updates.

compression.description: If true, serve gzip-compressed files when available and requested by the client.

upstream_proxy.description: Optional upstream HTTP/HTTPS proxy (e.g., 'http://proxy.example.com:8080'). Leave empty if none.

upstream_proxy_auth.description: Proxy authentication credentials in 'user:pass' format. Only set if needed.

exclusions.description: List of URL patterns (glob-style) to skip caching for. Example: '*/pool/debug/*' excludes debug symbol packages.

pattern.description: Glob-style pattern to exclude from caching.

repo_overrides.description: Custom per-repository configuration blocks for non-standard repos.

enabled.description: If true, this override is active.

base_url.description: Base URL to remap for this repo (e.g., 'http://mirror.local/repo/' → 'remap_custom: http://mirror.local/repo/').
